e.title: CAS Monograph 13 · mg-credibility
e.summary: CAS Monograph 13 信度与惩罚回归案例复现代码（Glenn Meyers，MPL-2.0）
e.body: mg-credibility 是 CAS Monograph 13《Penalized Regression and Lasso Credibility》案例研究的复现代码（R）：覆盖惩罚回归与 lasso 信度——把经典信度理论与现代正则化方法打通的关键专著配套代码。作者 Glenn Meyers（CAS 著名研究者），MPL-2.0。对 RIAA：学信度理论从经典到现代的正规路径。与 [[credibility]]（信度理论）条目互补——一个是概念，这里是完整专著+代码。关联 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。
e.verified_note: GitHub API + README 核实：CAS Monograph 13 案例复现代码，8★，MPL-2.0，R，信度+惩罚回归/lasso
e.summary_en: Code to replicate the CAS Monograph 13 case study on penalized regression and lasso credibility (Glenn Meyers, MPL-2.0)
e.summary_hk: CAS Monograph 13 信度與懲罰回歸案例複現代碼（Glenn Meyers，MPL-2.0）
e.body_en: mg-credibility provides the R code to replicate the case study in CAS Monograph 13: 'Penalized Regression and Lasso Credibility' — the companion code that connects classical credibility theory with modern regularization methods. Author Glenn Meyers is a prominent CAS researcher; MPL-2.0. For RIAA: the canonical path for learning credibility from classical to modern. Complements the [[credibility]] (credibility theory) entry — one is the concept, this is the full monograph plus code. Related: [[machine-learning-pricing]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[actuar-r]].
e.body_hk: mg-credibility 是 CAS Monograph 13《Penalized Regression and Lasso Credibility》案例研究的複現代碼（R）：覆蓋懲罰回歸與 lasso 信度——把經典信度理論與現代正則化方法打通的关键專著配套代碼。作者 Glenn Meyers（CAS 著名研究者），MPL-2.0。對 RIAA：學信度理論從經典到現代的正規路徑。與 [[credibility]]（信度理論）條目互補——一個是概念，這裡是完整專著+代碼。關聯 [[machine-learning-pricing]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[actuar-r]]。
